title: Whole Life Insurance Policy Form: Loan Provision
content:
**Product:** Whole Life Insurance — every Ashgrove tier.

## Clauses in force

1. **When a loan may be taken.** The owner may borrow against the policy from the tier's first loan policy year. The first loan policy year, the loan value percentage, the smallest new loan and the loan interest rate are each set per tier.
2. **Status.** A policy loan is advanced only while the policy status is in force, in the grace period, paid-up or reduced paid-up, as shown on the system record of that policy.
3. **Request.** An owner loan is advanced only on a loan request whose request status is approved; a loan request signed by the owner is approved when the amount is within the loan value. The approved request on file is the authority for the advance, and it is the request for that loan.
4. **Loan value available.** The loan value available is the tier's loan value percentage of the guaranteed cash value plus the paid-up additions cash value from the most recent anniversary statement, rounded to the cent, less the loan balance, less the loan interest accrued since the loan interest paid-to date. For this purpose the accrued loan interest is the loan balance multiplied by the tier's loan interest rate and by the actual calendar days from the loan interest paid-to date to the transaction date, divided by 365, rounded to the cent. Dividend accumulations are not loan value.
5. **Minimum.** A new owner loan must be at least the tier's smallest new loan.
6. **Modified endowment contracts.** On a modified endowment contract the loan is a taxable distribution to the extent of the gain in the contract, and federal tax is withheld at the default withholding rate of the taxable part unless the owner elected no withholding on the request.
7. **Automatic premium loans.** An automatic premium loan follows the grace period provision and needs no request.
8. **Extended term.** Extended term coverage has no loan value.

## Retired clause

The former clause stating that loan interest accrues at the tier's loan interest rate, simple, for actual calendar days over 365 and is due on each anniversary is **no longer in force**. It is superseded by the current Ashgrove basis for the loan interest charged when interest is capitalized on an anniversary and when a loan is extinguished at an offset.

## Status test

| Policy status | Loan may be advanced |
|---|---|
| In force | Yes |
| Grace period | Yes |
| Paid-up | Yes |
| Reduced paid-up | Yes |

## Worked loan value (hypothetical, loan value percentage 92%, loan interest rate 6%)

Guaranteed cash value 30000.00 and paid-up additions cash value 5000.00 on the latest anniversary statement; loan balance 8000.00; loan interest paid-to date 73 days before the transaction date.

- 92% of 35000.00 is 32200.00.
- Accrued interest: 8000.00 times 0.06 times 73, divided by 365, that is 96.00.
- Loan value available: 32200.00 less 8000.00 less 96.00, that is 24104.00.

superseded_clauses: Interest accrues at loan_interest_rate, simple, for actual calendar days over 365, and is due on each anniversary.
